trust_decision.summary: Song URIs taken from untrusted playlist file contents (XSPF/ASX/RSS location/href, PLS FileN) must be non-empty and contain no newline before becoming DetachedSongs, because they are later emitted raw as 'file: <uri>\n' protocol lines and line-based save files; decided in each playlist parser's end-of-entry handler via the new VerifyUriUTF8 (protocol/Verify).

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names XspfPlaylistPlugin.cxx; the track-end handler only checks location.empty() before emplacing the song.

fix_sites.entry_point: protocol commands load / listplaylist / listplaylistinfo / searchplaylist on a .xspf playlist (stored, music-dir or remote URL)
same commands on a .rss podcast feed

fix_sites.module_kind: playlist parser plugin (line-based INI); line splitting already excludes newlines, so this site effectively only drops empty FileN entries

fix_sites.entry_point: new helper VerifyUriUTF8 added after src/protocol/Verify.cxx:44, called by the four plugins

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All fixed sites are sibling plugins in src/playlist/plugins/; the only other file is the shared helper in src/protocol/Verify.cxx. None is a second implementation or a different layer.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Summary names only XSPF; a solver could argue ASX/RSS are 'different formats' not in the report and PLS is line-based so cannot carry a newline; for the UPnP DB route (O8), 'that is the database plugin fed by a UPnP server, not a playlist file'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate URIs with spaces, Unicode, percent-encoding, http(s) URLs with credentials (stripped by uri_remove_auth on print) and relative paths resolved against the playlist's base must keep loading; titles with control chars are already sanitised to spaces by TagBuilder rather than dropped. An over-broad fix (rejecting non-printable/non-ASCII URIs, escaping in song_print_uri, or sanitising URIs instead of dropping) breaks these or changes the song identity.

O6_input_shapes:
newline inside XSPF <location> text (character data, incl. 
 entity)
newline inside ASX <ref href=...> attribute value
newline inside RSS <enclosure url=...> attribute value
empty location / empty PLS FileN slot (entries vector resized with gaps)

O7_producer.where: expat end-element callbacks build DetachedSong (src/playlist/plugins/XspfPlaylistPlugin.cxx:150, :133); consumers that cross a save/reload boundary are src/PlaylistSave.cxx:38-49 (stored playlist, one URI per line) and src/queue/Save.cxx:27 (state file 'idx:uri' lines)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: UPnP database: path segment (object.name) taken from raw DIDL <dc:title> text and object id from raw XML attributes become song URIs printed as 'file:' lines; only '/' is replaced, newline is not checked
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Database plugin fed by a UPnP media server, not a playlist file; different feature and package from the advisory's playlist parsers; needs a UPnP server to exercise.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: src/db/plugins/upnp/ vs src/playlist/plugins/ (different package); also src/db/plugins/upnp/UpnpDatabasePlugin.cxx:325-330 (songPath from objid) and :381-397 (BuildPath from names)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second XSPF element (e.g. <link> or an image/identifier fallback) promoted to the song URI when <location> is absent
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: XSPF has several URI-valued elements; a maintainer adding a fallback would copy the location assignment without the end-of-track check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ASX <entryref href> or <ref> outside <entry> handled in a separate branch that emplaces directly
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ASX allows entryref/ref variants; a separate code path for them is a natural addition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a URI-bearing field taken from a non-line-delimited source (e.g. a tag value) instead of the line-split FILE command
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Embedded cue already feeds tag values into the parser (src/playlist/plugins/EmbeddedCuePlaylistPlugin.cxx:104); a variant that keeps the CUE FILE value from a multi-line tag would bypass line splitting.

O9_family: CWE-93 CRLF/line injection into the MPD text protocol and line-based save files via playlist-supplied song URIs

O10_build.toolchain: meson + ninja, gcc/clang; deps expat (XSPF/ASX/RSS), fmt, gtest for tests
O10_build.project_tests: test/playlist/TestPlsPlaylistPlugin.cxx (PLS parser gtest, test/playlist/meson.build:6); no XSPF/ASX/RSS or Verify tests at the pinned commit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a newline check to XspfPlaylistPlugin's track-end handler only (or strip newlines in song_print_uri), missing ASX/RSS and the save/state-file consumers.

out_of_scope_notes: VerifyStringUTF8 rejects only '\n', not '\r' (src/protocol/Verify.cxx:24); whether CR matters to clients is not examined.
Neighbor listing prints UPnP/SMB-supplied names raw (src/command/NeighborCommands.cxx:33); not pursued.
unverified: O1 counts the four fixed parser plugins; the exact set of protocol commands reaching each was inferred from src/playlist/Print.cxx and not enumerated in src/command/.
UPnP O8 route requires a UPnP server at runtime; whether DIDL titles/ids with newlines survive libupnp/expat unchanged was not confirmed.
